providers.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider
REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.

limitations: Fuse state does not prove the application enables Inspector through other means, such as app.commandLine or a remote-debugging switch in application code.
A missing sentinel means fuse state is unknown, not that every fuse is disabled.
Electron compiles embedded ASAR integrity validation only on macOS and Windows; the observed fuse byte at file offset 37183328 does not establish enforcement.
The selected file is admitted as one regular file of at most 1 GiB. Sentinel search uses 262144-byte windows, and each slice keeps at most 32 sentinels.

Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Shared-context network capture excludes requests without a known root or descendant Page frame.
CDP attachment cannot recover pre-attach events or guarantee launch-time context options.
Attached locale en-US applies to Intl formatting only; navigator.language(s) and Accept-Language remain caller-controlled. Use launch mode for matching page and request languages.

Detaching a CDP page session may clear caller-owned navigator.platform emulation. REA cannot snapshot the caller's complete user-agent/client-hint state before attachment; use launch mode to avoid mutating that external browser.
